title: Certified Mechanistic Interpretability: Lifting Single-Input Findings to Bounded Neighbourhoods
abstract: arXiv:2609.26112v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability reverse-engineers transformer circuits one input at a time, leaving observed mechanisms without guarantees over bounded input neighbourhoods. We address this gap with a framework based on constrained polynomial-zonotope (CPZ) propagation that lifts mechanistic-interpretability observations from a single input to certified statements over a bounded set of perturbations. Three internal-attention queries (top-$k$ stability, evidence mass, and attention entropy) are formulated as tractable programs over the simplex of attention weights, and CPZ propagation through transformer blocks is shown to preserve the softmax simplex and the LayerNorm zero-mean identity exactly. A recursive Jacobian zonotope construction extends the same certificates across layer depth by linearising the block stack at the input and avoids per-layer generator growth. translated_title: 认证式机制可解释性：将单输入发现提升至有界邻域
translated_abstract: 机制可解释性逐个输入地对Transformer电路进行逆向工程，这使得观察到的机制在有界输入邻域上缺乏保证。我们通过一个基于约束多项式zonotope（CPZ）传播的框架来填补这一空白，该框架将机制可解释性的观察结果从单个输入提升为针对有界扰动集合的认证性陈述。三种内部注意力查询（top-k稳定性、证据质量和注意力熵）被表述为在注意力权重单纯形上的可求解程序，并且证明了CPZ在Transformer块中的传播能够精确保持softmax单纯形和LayerNorm零均值恒等式。一种递归雅可比zonotope构造通过在输入处对块堆叠进行线性化，将同样的证书扩展至整个网络深度，并避免了逐层生成元数量的增长。我们在Transformer注意力上实例化了该框架；由此产生的认证……
tldr: 该论文提出基于约束多项式zonotope（CPZ）传播的认证框架，将机制可解释性中针对单个输入的发现提升为对有界输入邻域的可认证保证，并能精确保持softmax单纯形和LayerNorm零均值性质。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a certified framework based on constrained polynomial-zonotope (CPZ) propagation that lifts single-input mechanistic interpretability findings to certified guarantees over bounded input neighbourhoods, exactly preserving the softmax simplex and LayerNorm zero-mean identity.
